verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any data-export or account-exit capability for AvaTax, and no open export formats are named. The MCP/API tools that list and retrieve transactions are developer building blocks a user could script into an export. They are not a documented full-data export in open formats, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Retrieves a list of transactions for a specific company, using filters to search.
